title: Quietly Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：quietly　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quietly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Quietly, in 1967 the planner folded the plan at the square, and everybody in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the planner had ② quietly folded the plan, and nobody had asked a single question. The planner had come to the district two years earlier, and spoke little of the district he had left behind him.

The report for March 1961 puts it plainer. The plan was ③ quietly certain, and the citizen who kept it had ④ quietly measured it twice before the winter came; nothing in the district was ever done quietly in those days. The citizen wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else. He folded the plan ⑤ more quietly than anybody else in the district, and of all who folded it that year he folded it ⑥ the most quietly of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the district had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1974 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the plan be measured ⑦ quietly every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ quietly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done quietly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1977 she folded the plan ⑨ quietly for the whole place when nobody else would, and ⑩ Quietly, she said in 1979, that was the part the district never forgot; the report still speaks quietly of it. She kept the plan in the same square for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the district never forgot how quietly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 轻声地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had quietly folded …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 轻声地（修饰形容词：quietly certain）
C. adv. 平静地（评注性状语，置于句首：Quietly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 平静地（修饰过去分词：had quietly measured it）
E. adv. 轻声地（比较级 more quietly than：拿叔叔跟街区里其他人相比）
F. adv. 轻声地（最高级 the most quietly of all of them：那个年份所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 平静地（被动结构中的中位状语：be measured quietly）
H. adv. 平静地（修饰形容词：be quietly careful about the whole business）

answers.why: quietly 意为“轻声地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Quietly, in 1967 …。
quietly 意为“轻声地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had quietly folded the plan。
quietly 意为“轻声地”，此处修饰形容词 certain（确定）：was quietly certain。
quietly 意为“平静地”，此处修饰过去分词 measured：had quietly measured it twice。
quietly 意为“轻声地”，拿叔叔跟街区里所有人相比，故用比较级 more quietly than。
quietly 意为“轻声地”，那个年份里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most quietly of all of them。
quietly 意为“平静地”，被动结构 be measured quietly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
quietly 意为“平静地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be quietly careful about the whole business。
quietly 意为“轻声地”，1977 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次折好那件薄薄的图纸，副词置于动词之后。
quietly 意为“平静地”，母亲 1979 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Quietly, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，规划员平静地在广场折好那件薄薄的图纸；街区里人人都说那是头一回。（Quietly, …）
雨季到来之前，规划员已经轻声地折好那件薄薄的图纸。（had quietly folded …）
那件薄薄的图纸当时轻声地确定。（quietly certain）
保管它的那位市民在入冬前已经平静地把它丈量过两回。（had quietly measured it）
叔叔做这件事比街区里任何人都来得轻声地。（more quietly than …）
在那个年份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最轻声地。（the most quietly of all of them）
answers: Quietly, in 1967 the planner folded the plan at the square.
Before the March rains the planner had quietly folded the plan.
The citizen who kept it had quietly measured it twice before the winter came.
He folded the plan more quietly than anybody else in the district.
Of all who did it that year, he did it the most quietly of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Quietly, in 1967 the planner folded the plan, and nobody forgot it.
Before the March rains the planner had quietly folded the plan.
The plan was quietly certain, or so the report says.
The citizen had quietly measured it twice before the winter came.
